MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which sentence means "Tomorrow is Thursday."? (1 mark)
   A. 星期五,去清真寺。
   B. 我星期三去学校。
   C. 明天是星期四。
   D. 今天星期三。

2. Which word for a family member has 女 at the start? (1 mark)
   A. 儿子
   B. 女儿
   C. 弟弟
   D. 爸爸

3. What is the Chinese question for "Where is the television?" (1 mark)
   A. 电视在哪儿?
   B. 电视有什么?
   C. 这是电视吗?
   D. 电视是谁?

4. What does 星期 xīngqī mean? (1 mark)
   A. Day
   B. Week
   C. Year
   D. Month

5. Which sentence means "The rain is heavy."? (1 mark)
   A. 今天天气很好。
   B. 雨很大。
   C. 风很小。
   D. 这是太阳。

6. What does 早上 zǎoshang mean? (1 mark)
   A. Morning
   B. Afternoon
   C. Evening
   D. Night

7. What does 姐姐 (jiějie) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Mother
   B. Older sister
   C. Love
   D. To have, there is

8. Which sentence means "I drink tea."? (1 mark)
   A. 我早饭吃饼。
   B. 我喝茶。
   C. 我喜欢喝茶。
   D. 这是什么?

9. What does 那是我哥哥 nà shì wǒ gēge mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is my sister
   B. That is my older brother
   C. This is my younger brother
   D. That is my mother

10. Which Chinese word means "Wednesday"? (1 mark)
   A. 清真寺 qīngzhēnsì
   B. 周 zhōu
   C. 星期三 xīngqīsān
   D. 四 sì

11. Which Chinese word means "to eat"? (1 mark)
   A. 茶 chá
   B. 肉 ròu
   C. 饮料 yǐnliào
   D. 吃 chī

12. What does 很 (hěn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Cloud
   B. Small
   C. Big
   D. Very

13. Which sentence means "Where is the sofa?"? (1 mark)
   A. 床在卧室。
   B. 冰箱在厨房。
   C. 沙发在哪儿?
   D. 门在左边。

14. Read the pinyin: kètīng lǐ yǒu diànshì. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. The window is above the sofa.
   B. The door is on the left.
   C. The television is on the table.
   D. There is a television in the living room.

15. Fill the blank: 这是____? (Who is this?) (1 mark)
   A. 几
   B. 哪儿
   C. 谁
   D. 什么

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 客厅 and 咖啡. (2 marks)

17. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: wǒ xīngqīsān qù xuéxiào. (2 marks)

18. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "There is a bed in the bedroom." (2 marks)

19. Write the stroke order of 大 in Chinese stroke names. (2 marks)

20. Give two things to put in a reading journal. (2 marks)

21. Describe how to make the character 手 using local materials. (3 marks)

22. Give one challenge of writing Chinese and one way to overcome it. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — 明天是星期四。
   明天是星期四。 (míngtiān shì xīngqīsì.) means "Tomorrow is Thursday.".

2. B — 女儿
   女儿 is daughter.

3. A — 电视在哪儿?
   哪儿 is where and takes the place of the answer.

4. B — Week
   星期 followed by a number makes the day names.

5. B — 雨很大。
   雨很大。 (yǔ hěn dà.) means "The rain is heavy.".

6. A — Morning
   早上 is morning.

7. B — Older sister
   姐姐 (jiějie) means older sister.

8. B — 我喝茶。
   我喝茶。 (wǒ hē chá.) means "I drink tea.".

9. B — That is my older brother
   那 is that and 哥哥 is older brother.

10. C — 星期三 xīngqīsān
   星期三 (xīngqīsān) means Wednesday.

11. D — 吃 chī
   吃 (chī) means to eat.

12. D — Very
   很 (hěn) means very.

13. C — 沙发在哪儿?
   沙发在哪儿? (shāfā zài nǎr?) means "Where is the sofa?".

14. D — There is a television in the living room.
   kètīng lǐ yǒu diànshì. is 客厅里有电视。, which means "There is a television in the living room.".

15. C — 谁
   谁 means who.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: 客厅: kètīng, living room. 咖啡: kāfēi, coffee.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: On Wednesday I go to school.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: 卧室里有床。 wòshì lǐ yǒu chuáng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: 横, 撇, 捺.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for all three in order, 1 mark for two.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: New words with pinyin and meaning, sentences you can read well, or a recording of yourself reading.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Choose pebbles, sand, maize grains, sticks or plasticine. Lay out each stroke in the correct order: 撇, 横, 横, 竖钩. Check the order with a partner.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the material, 1 mark for the order, 1 mark for checking.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example, remembering stroke order; practise a few characters each day and use flashcards.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
